`trigger-v2-state.json` is a fixed input for the documented existing version-2
Trigger state representation. It uses the checked-in advanced-kit document with
the kick remapped from MIDI36 to60 and the23 independently specified nondefault
physical values from the host state's signed-PCM test. It is not generated by
whichever writer is under test. The copied-CLAP test first loads these exact bytes
and asserts every physical value and two literal signed frames, then tests the
portable representation carrying the same logical input and actual WAV bytes.
